answer: Require each identity to carry a verifiable thread of prior useful work: each task is signed by its requester and an independent checker, forming a chain that cannot be copied to a new key. Reward weight grows only with the length and diversity of that thread, not with account count. A tide of fresh identities thus adds no influence until each one has done checked work, while a zephyr of random spot audits re-verifies old work and revokes weight on fraud. Forging one credible identity costs as much work as earning one, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times the effort, with no shortcut.
